title: Bank import & reconciliation
description: Import bank statements (CSV/XLSX), review suggested matches, then Approve, Change, or Ignore. Nothing posts to payments, bills, or project cost until you act elsewhere.

liveFeed.title: Live bank feed
liveFeed.body: Live bank connections are not configured. Use CSV or XLSX import for now.

accounts.title: Bank accounts
accounts.empty: No bank accounts yet. Add one to start importing statements.

import.title: Import statement
import.hint: Upload a CSV or paste CSV text. XLSX can be converted to CSV before paste. Duplicates are skipped.
import.success: Imported {imported} rows. Skipped {duplicates} duplicates. Invalid rows: {invalid}.
import.noFinancialWrite: Import never creates payments, bills, or expenses.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.empty: No transactions yet. Import a statement to begin reconciliation.

suggestions.title: Suggested matches
suggestions.incomingHint: Incoming lines suggest customer payments or billing records.
suggestions.outgoingHint: Outgoing lines suggest vendor payments or vendor bills.
suggestions.costGuard: Matching a vendor payment for an already-recognized bill is cash only - it does not add project cost.

actions.approved: Match approved (reconciliation only - no ledger write).
actions.changed: Match changed (reconciliation only - no ledger write).
actions.selectTarget: Select a suggestion or enter a target before Approve / Change.

errors.incomingTarget: Incoming bank lines can only match customer payment or billing.
errors.outgoingTarget: Outgoing bank lines can only match vendor payment or bill.
errors.targetRequired: Approve / Change requires a match target.
errors.currencyMismatch: Match currency must match the bank transaction.
errors.overApply: Applied amount cannot exceed the bank transaction amount.
errors.mappingRequired: Map date, description, and amount (or debit/credit) columns.
errors.accountArchived: Cannot import into an archived bank account.
errors.needAccount: Select or create a bank account first.
errors.schemaPending: Saving a bank account is not available in this environment yet.
errors.crossOrgTarget: Match target must belong to the same organization.
errors.crossOrgAccount: Bank account must belong to the same organization.
errors.crossOrgImport: Import batch must belong to the same organization and account.
